第24章 打破多项基地记录，遥遥领先-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

上一章

存书签

下一章

顾承安重新戴上眼罩。

这次他刻意放慢了一点速度。不能太离谱，第一次已经够炸了，总得给人留点消化的余地。

9秒11。

依旧快了教官将近一倍。

教官拿起记录本，记录上这个数字。

他看顾承安的眼神都变了，不再是看学员的审视，更像是灰太狼看到了X羊羊。

“下一个科目。”

故障排除训练。

教官亲手准备了五种实战中最常见的枪械故障：卡壳、哑弹、弹匣卡死、复进簧错位、击针断裂。每一种都是外勤一线可能要命的问题。

“蒙眼，手指识别故障类型，排除并复位。合格线30秒。”

前面五个学员的成绩参差不齐。最快的02用了26秒，已经算优秀。

003在击针断裂那个故障上卡了很久，不及格。

顾承安上场。

戴上眼罩。

他甚至没有逐一排查，手指头划过枪身的同时，五个故障点的位置、类型、排除方式就已经全部锁定了。

六秒。

全部故障排除完毕，枪身复位，他顺手扣动扳机——

空仓挂机声在安静的训练室里格外清脆。

教官这次没有让他再来一遍。

他沉默了几秒，走到射击区，按下控制面板上的一个开关。七米距离上，一个人形靶缓缓升起。

“加一个科目。”

教官的声音沉了下来，不是生气，是认真。是真正认真对待一个值得认真的对手时才会有的那种认真。

“7米近距离战术速射。拔枪、上膛、击发五发，全部命中十环。往届最好成绩——2秒03。”

顾承安站上射击位。

92G手枪插在腰间的快拔枪套里。他活动了一下手指，闭上眼睛。

默默调整了下状态。

睁眼。

“准备好了喊。”教官举起秒表。

“好了。”

“开始。”

五声枪响，几乎连成一声。

在场所有人只看到一个画面：手落在枪套上的下一个瞬间，枪已经平举在眼前，然后是连续的闷响和套筒的高速往复运动。

计时器定格在了——0.87。

Gu Chengan put on the blindfold again.

This time he deliberately slowed down a little.It can’t be too outrageous. The first time was already explosive enough, so you have to leave some room for digestion.

9 seconds 11.

Still nearly twice as fast as the instructor.

The instructor picked up the record book and recorded this number.

The way he looked at Gu Chengan changed. It was no longer looking at the students, but more like Big Big Wolf looking at X Sheep.

"Next subject."

Troubleshooting training.

The instructor personally prepared the five most common firearm failures in actual combat: jamming, dumb ammunition, jammed magazine, misaligned recoil spring, and broken firing pin.Each of these is a potentially fatal problem on the front line in the field.

"Blindfold your eyes and use your fingers to identify the type of fault, eliminate it and reset it. 30 seconds for the qualified line."

The results of the first five students were mixed.The fastest 02 took 26 seconds, which is already considered excellent.

003 was stuck for a long time on the fault of broken firing pin and failed.

Gu Chengan comes on stage.

Wear a blindfold.

He didn't even check one by one. As his fingers ran across the gun body, the locations, types, and troubleshooting methods of the five fault points were all locked.

Six seconds.

After all the faults were eliminated, the gun body was reset, and he pulled the trigger——

The sound of empty warehouse hanging up was particularly clear in the quiet training room.

The instructor did not let him do it again this time.

He was silent for a few seconds, then walked to the shooting area and pressed a switch on the control panel.At a distance of seven meters, a human-shaped target slowly rose.

"Add a subject."

The instructor's voice dropped, not angry, but serious.It's the kind of seriousness you get when you really take an opponent who is worthy of seriousness.

"Tactical rapid fire at close range of 7 meters. Draw the gun, load the gun, and fire five rounds, all hitting ten rings. The best result in the past is 2 seconds 03."

Gu Chengan stood in the shooting position.

The 92G pistol is inserted into the quick-draw holster on the waist.He flexed his fingers and closed his eyes.

Silently adjusted the status.

Open your eyes.

"Shout when you're ready." The instructor raised the stopwatch.

"Okay."

"Start."

Five gunshots were fired, almost in succession.

Everyone present only saw one scene: the next moment the hand landed on the holster, the gun was already held flat in front of the eyes, followed by a continuous muffled sound and the high-speed reciprocating motion of the holster.

The timer stopped at - 0.87.
